The Manager, Cyber Risk Services is responsible for the operational leadership, administrative oversight, and day-to-day management of all cyber risk and compliance functions within the assigned area across UCI Health. The incumbent is accountable for implementing the cyber risk and compliance strategy as directed by the Chief Information Security Officer, including oversight of third-party and vendor risk, security risk assessments, risk management, audit response and remediation, research security, and security review of contracts and data agreements. This role maintains responsibility for translating organizational goals into actionable team priorities and an effective operating model, driving measurable improvements in speed, quality, and risk reduction. The Manager provides direct oversight to all assigned functional areas, ensuring the selection, onboarding, competency validation, performance evaluation, and professional development of cyber risk coworkers. This position collaborates closely with information security, compliance, research administration, legal, and operational leadership to support enterprise-wide risk mitigation and regulatory readiness. The Manager exercises independent judgment in managing day-to-day cyber risk operations and the execution of established program objectives.
Management expertise, including directing technical staff, managing performance, strategic planning, technology assessment, and change management

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to build relationships with leaders and business units, influence decisions, and explain risk clearly to executive and non-technical audiences, both orally and in writing.
